protocol_version_hash.description: REQUIRED part of the receipt content core (added in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/): sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical bytes of the complete ProtocolVersion object named by protocol_version_id (the ProtocolVersion contains no hash of itself, so the preimage is non-self-referential). MUST equal the canonical hash of that ProtocolVersion (rule RECEIPT_PROTOCOL_VERSION_HASH_MATCH).

commitment_type.description: Optional derived copy of the referenced CommitmentPoint's commitment_type (added in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/): one of the eight core values, or the literal EXTENSION when the CommitmentPoint is extension-typed (widened in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/). If present it MUST match the referenced CommitmentPoint's type — EXTENSION matches EXTENSION (rule RECEIPT_COMMITMENT_TYPE_MATCH).

commitment_type_extension_id.description: Optional; when commitment_type is EXTENSION this MAY carry the extension type id declared by the CommitmentPoint's commitment_type_extension (added in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/).

ai_assistance.description: Optional AI-assistance provenance for the accepted commitment (added in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/).

issuer.description: Reserved for forward compatibility; unsigned in v0.1 (ADR-003).

signatures.description: Reserved for forward compatibility; unsigned in v0.1 (ADR-003).
